description: This is an awesome theme tune. For ANYthing. You got a dark comedy about an inept biologist? This will work. A gritty fantasy dealing with fairy politics? A sci-fi dystopian future where everyone likes sardines? A reality show about bicycle thieves? A  slice-of-life serial about growing up in the Upper Peninsula? Seriously. Anything.
instruments: Piano, Basses, Cellos, Flutes, Clarinets, Oboes, English Horn, Percussion
